verses.text: “You, son of man, prophesy to di mountains of Israel, and talk, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear di word of di Lord.
Di Lord God talk like dis: Because di enemy don talk against una, “Aha!” and, “Di ancient high places don become our possession,”

therefore prophesy, and talk: Di Lord God talk like dis: Because dem don make una desolate, and swallow una up on every side, so that una don become possession to di rest of di nations, and una dey taken up for di lips of talkers, and di evil report of di people,

therefore, una mountains of Israel, hear di word of di Lord God: Di Lord God talk like dis to di mountains and to di hills, to di watercourses and to di valleys, to di desolate wastes and to di cities wey dem forsake, wey don become prey and derision to di rest of di nations wey dey round about,

therefore di Lord God talk like dis: Surely for di fire of my jealousy I don speak against di rest of di nations, and against all Edom, wey don appoint my land to demselves for possession with di joy of all dem heart, with despite of soul, to cast am out for prey.

Therefore prophesy concerning di land of Israel, and talk to di mountains and to di hills, to di watercourses and to di valleys: Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I don speak for my jealousy and for my wrath, because una don bear di shame of di nations.
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: I don lift up my hand, say di nations wey dey round about una go bear dem shame.
But una, mountains of Israel, go shoot forth una branches, and yield una fruit to my people Israel, because dem dey near to come.
Because see, I dey for una, and I go turn to una, and una go dey tilled and sown.
I go multiply men on una, all di house of Israel, even all of am. Di cities go dey inhabited, and di waste places go dey built.
I go multiply on una man and animal, and dem go increase and bring fruit. I go cause una to dwell as for una former times, and go do better to una pass una beginnings. Una go know say I be di Lord.
Yes, I go cause men to waka on una, even my people Israel. Dem go possess una, and una go be dem inheritance, and una no go again bereave dem of children.
Di Lord God talk like dis: Because dem talk to una, “You na devourer of men, and don bereave your nations of children,”
therefore you no go devour men any more, neither bereave your nations of children any more,’ talk di Lord God.
I no go cause men hear di shame of di nations any more, neither you go bear di reproach of di peoples any more, neither you go cause your nations to stumble any more,” talk di Lord God.
Moreover di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, when di house of Israel dwell for dem own land, dem defile am by dem own way and by dem doings. Dem way before me na like di uncleanness of woman wey dey in her period.
So I pour out my wrath on dem for di blood wey dem don shed on di land, and because dem don defile am with dem idols.
I scatter dem among di nations, and dem dey dispersed through di countries. According to dem way and according to dem doings I judge dem.
When dem come to di nations, wherever dem go, dem profane my holy name, in that men talk of dem, ‘Dis na di people of di Lord, and dem don go out of im land.’
But I get concern for my holy name, wey di house of Israel don profane among di nations, wherever dem go.
Therefore talk to di house of Israel, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: I no do dis for una sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name sake, wey una don profane among di nations, wherever una go.

I go sanctify my great name, wey dem don profane among di nations, wey una don profane for di middle of dem. Di nations go know say I be di Lord,’ talk di Lord God, ‘when I go dey sanctified inside una before dem eyes.
Because I go take una from among di nations, and gather una out of all di countries, and bring una into una own land.
Den I go sprinkle clean water on una, and una go dey clean. From all una filthiness, and from all una idols, I go cleanse una.
I go also give una new heart, and I go put new spirit inside una. I go take away di stony heart out of una flesh, and I go give una heart of flesh.
I go put my Spirit inside una, and cause una to waka for my statutes. Una go keep my ordinances, and do dem.
Una go dwell for di land wey I give to una fathers. Una go be my people, and I go be una God.
I go also save una from all una uncleanness. I go call for di grain, and multiply am, and lay no famine on una.
I go multiply di fruit of di tree, and di increase of di field, so that una no go receive di reproach of famine among di nations any more.
Den una go remember una evil ways, and una doings wey no good, and una go loathe yourselves for una own sight for una iniquities and for una abominations.
I no do dis for una sake,’ talk di Lord God. ‘Make una know am. Dey ashamed and confounded for una own ways, house of Israel.
Di Lord God talk like dis: For di day wey I cleanse una from all una iniquities, I go also cause di cities to dey inhabited, and di waste places go dey built.
Di land wey dey desolate go dey tilled, whereas e dey desolation for di sight of all wey pass by.
Dem go talk, “Dis land wey dey desolate don become like di garden of Eden. Di waste and desolate and ruined cities dey fortified, and dem dey inhabited.”
Den di nations wey remain round about una go know say I, di Lord, don build di ruined places, and plant dat wey dey desolate. I, di Lord, don speak am, and I go do am.’
Di Lord God talk like dis: ‘I go still dey inquired of by di house of Israel, to do dis for dem. I go increase dem with men like flock.
As di flock for sacrifice, as di flock of Jerusalem for her appointed feasts, so di waste cities go dey filled with flocks of men. Dem go know say I be di Lord.’”
Di hand of di Lord dey on me, and e bring me out for di Spirit of di Lord, and set me down for di middle of di valley. E dey full of bones.
E cause me to pass by dem round about. See, plenty dey for di open valley, and see, dem dey very dry.
E talk to me, “Son of man, dem bones fit live?” I answer, “Lord God, you know.”
Again e talk to me, “Prophesy over dis bones, and talk to dem, ‘You dry bones, hear di word of di Lord.
Di Lord God talk like dis to dis bones: See, I go cause breath enter inside you, and you go live.
I go lay sinews on you, and go bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath inside you, and you go live. Den you go know say I be di Lord.’”
So I prophesy as I dey commanded. As I prophesy, noise dey, and see, rattling, and di bones come together, bone to im bone.
I look, and see, sinews dey on dem, and flesh come up, and skin cover dem above, but no breath dey inside dem.
Den e talk to me, “Prophesy to di breath, prophesy, son of man, and talk to di breath, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: Come from di four winds, breath, and breathe on dis slain, so that dem go live.’”
So I prophesy as e command me, and di breath come inside dem, and dem live, and stand up on dem feet, exceeding great army.
Den e talk to me, “Son of man, dis bones na di whole house of Israel. See, dem talk, ‘Our bones dey dried up, and our hope don lost. We dey cut off completely.’
Therefore prophesy, and talk to dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people. I go bring you into di land of Israel.
Una go know say I be di Lord, when I don open una graves, and cause una to come up out of una graves, my people.
I go put my Spirit inside una, and una go live, and I go place una for una own land. Den una go know say I, di Lord, don speak am and don perform am,’ talk di Lord.”
Di word of di Lord come to me again, say,

“You, son of man, take one stick, and write on am, ‘For Judah, and for di children of Israel im companions.’ Den take another stick, and write on am, ‘For Joseph, di stick of Ephraim, and for all di house of Israel im companions.’
Join dem for yourself one to another into one stick, so that dem go become one for your hand.
When di children of your people go speak to you, saying, ‘You no go show us wetin you mean by dis?’

talk to dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go take di stick of Joseph, wey dey di hand of Ephraim, and di tribes of Israel im companions, and I go put dem with am, even with di stick of Judah, and make dem one stick, and dem go be one for my hand.’
Di sticks wey you write on go dey for your hand before dem eyes.
Talk to dem, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I go take di children of Israel from among di nations where dem don go, and go gather dem on every side, and bring dem into dem own land.
I go make dem one nation for di land, upon di mountains of Israel. One king go be king to dem all. Dem no go be two nations any more, neither dem go dey divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

Neither dem go defile demselves any more with dem idols, nor with dem detestable things, nor with any of dem transgressions. But I go save dem out of all dem dwelling places, wherein dem don sin, and go cleanse dem. So dem go be my people, and I go be dem God.
My servant David go be king over dem. Dem all go get one shepherd. Dem go also waka for my ordinances, and keep my statutes, and do dem.

Dem go dwell for di land wey I don give to Jacob my servant, wherein una fathers don dwell. Dem go dwell dere, dem, and dem children, and dem children children, forever. David my servant go be dem prince forever.
Moreover I go make covenant of peace with dem. E go be everlasting covenant with dem. I go place dem, and multiply dem, and go set my sanctuary for di middle of dem forevermore.
My tabernacle go also dey with dem. Yes, I go be dem God, and dem go be my people.
Di nations go know say I, di Lord, sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary go dey for di middle of dem forevermore.’”
Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
“Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of di land of Magog, di prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against am,
and talk, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I dey against you, Gog, di prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

I go turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I go bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of dem clothed with all sorts of armour, great company with buckler and shield, all of dem handling swords.
Persia, Cush, and Put dey with dem, all of dem with shield and helmet.
Gomer, and all im hordes, Beth Togarmah from di uttermost parts of di north, and all im hordes, even many peoples with you.
Be prepared, and prepare for yourself, you and all your companies wey dey assembled to you, and be guard to dem.

After many days you go dey visited. For di latter years you go come into di land wey dey restored from di sword, wey dey gathered out of many peoples, against di mountains of Israel, wey don dey continually waste. But dem dey brought out of di peoples, and dem dey dwelling securely, all of dem.
You go go up, coming like storm. You go be like cloud to cover di land, you, and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.
Di Lord God talk like dis: E go happen for dat day, say things go come into your mind, and you go devise evil plan.
You go talk, “I go go up against di land of unwalled villages. I go go to dem wey dey quiet, wey dwell securely, all of dem dwelling without walls, and get neither bars nor gates,”

to take plunder and to take prey, to turn your hand against di waste places wey dey inhabited now, and against di people wey dey gathered out of di nations, wey don get cattle and goods, wey dwell for di middle of di earth.

Sheba, and Dedan, and di merchants of Tarshish, with all di young lions of am, go talk to you, “You don come to take plunder? You don gather your company to take prey? To carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take great plunder?”’
Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and talk to Gog, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: For dat day when my people Israel dey dwelling securely, you no go know am?
You go come from your place out of di uttermost parts of di north, you, and many peoples with you, all of dem riding on horses, great company and mighty army.

You go come up against my people Israel, like cloud to cover di land. E go be for di latter days, and I go bring you against my land, so that di nations go know me, when I go dey sanctified for you, Gog, before dem eyes.
Di Lord God talk like dis: Na you be im of whom I speak for old time by my servants di prophets of Israel, wey prophesy for dose days for many years say I go bring you against dem?
E go happen for dat same day, when Gog go come against di land of Israel,’ talk di Lord God, ‘say my wrath go come up for my nostrils.
For my jealousy and for di fire of my wrath I don speak, say surely for dat day great shaking go dey for di land of Israel,

so that di fish of di sea, and di birds of di sky, and di animals of di field, and all creeping things wey creep on di ground, and all di men wey dey upon di surface of di earth, go shake at my presence. Di mountains go dey thrown down, and di cliffs go fall, and every wall go fall to di ground.
I go call for sword against am to all my mountains,’ talk di Lord God. ‘Every man sword go dey against im brother.
I go plead against am with pestilence and with blood. I go rain on am, and on im hordes, and on di many peoples wey dey with am, overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire and sulfur.
I go magnify myself, and sanctify myself, and I go dey known for di eyes of many nations. Dem go know say I be di Lord.’”
“You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and talk, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: See, I dey against you, Gog, di prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
I go turn you around, and lead you on, and cause you to come up from di uttermost parts of di north, and I go bring you on di mountains of Israel.
I go strike your bow out of your left hand, and cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
You go fall on di mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and di peoples wey dey with you. I go give you to di ravenous birds of every sort, and to di animals of di field to dey devoured.
You go fall on di open field, because I don speak am,’ talk di Lord God.
‘I go send fire on Magog, and on dem wey dwell securely for di islands. Dem go know say I be di Lord.
I go make my holy name known for di middle of my people Israel, and I no go let dem profane my holy name any more. Di nations go know say I be di Lord, di Holy One for Israel.
See, e dey come, and e go dey done,’ talk di Lord God. ‘Dis na di day wey I don speak of.

Dem wey dwell for di cities of Israel go go out, and go make fires of di weapons and burn dem, both shields and bucklers, bows and arrows, and handstaves, and spears. Dem go make fires of dem for seven years,

so that dem no go take wood out of di field, neither cut down any out of di forests, because dem go make fires of di weapons. Dem go plunder dose wey plundered dem, and rob dose wey robbed dem,’ talk di Lord God.

‘E go happen for dat day, say I go give to Gog place dere for burial for Israel, di valley of di travelers on di east of di sea. E go block di noses of di travelers. Dere dem go bury Gog and all im multitude, and dem go call am di valley of Hamon Gog.
Seven months go di house of Israel dey burying dem, so that dem go cleanse di land.
Yes, all di people of di land go bury dem, and e go be to dem renown for di day wey I go dey glorified,’ talk di Lord God.

‘Dem go set apart men of continual employment, wey go pass through di land, wey with di travelers go bury dose wey remain on di surface of di earth, to cleanse am. After di end of seven months dem go search.
Di travelers go pass through di land, and when anyone see man bone, den e go set up marker by am, until di buriers don bury am for di valley of Hamon Gog.
Also di name of di city go be Hamonah. Thus dem go cleanse di land.’

You, son of man, di Lord God talk like dis: Speak to every sort of bird, and to every animal of di field, ‘Assemble yourselves, and come. Gather una yourselves from every side to my sacrifice wey I dey sacrifice for una, even great sacrifice upon di mountains of Israel, so that una go eat flesh and drink blood.
Una go eat di flesh of di mighty, and drink di blood of di princes of di earth, of rams, of lambs, and of male goats, of bulls, all of dem fatlings of Bashan.
Una go eat fat till una dey full, and drink blood till una dey drunk, of my sacrifice wey I don sacrifice for una.
Una go dey filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war,’ talk di Lord God.
‘I go set my glory among di nations, and all di nations go see my judgment wey I don execute, and my hand wey I don lay on dem.
So di house of Israel go know say I be di Lord dem God, from dat day and forward.

Di nations go know say di house of Israel go into captivity for dem iniquity, because dem trespass against me, and I hide my face from dem. So I give dem into di hand of dem adversaries, and dem all fall by di sword.
According to dem uncleanness and according to dem transgressions I do to dem, and I hide my face from dem.’
Therefore di Lord God talk like dis: ‘Now I go bring again di captivity of Jacob, and have mercy on di whole house of Israel, and I go dey jealous for my holy name.
Dem go bear dem shame, and all dem trespass wey dem don trespass against me, when dem dwell securely for dem land, and none go make dem afraid,
when I don bring dem again from di peoples, and gather dem out of dem enemies lands, and dey sanctified for dem for di sight of many nations.
Dem go know say I be di Lord dem God, in that I cause dem to go into captivity among di nations, and don gather dem into dem own land. I no go leave any of dem dere any more.
I no go hide my face any more from dem, because I don pour out my Spirit on di house of Israel,’ talk di Lord God.”

For di 25th year of our captivity, for di beginning of di year, for di tenth day of di month, for di 14th year after dat di city dey struck, for di same day, di hand of di Lord dey on me, and e bring me dere.
For di visions of God e bring me into di land of Israel, and set me down upon very high mountain, wey get something like building of city on di south.
E bring me dere, and see, man dey, wey im appearance be like di appearance of bronze, with line of flax for im hand, and measuring reed. E dey stand for di gate.

Di man talk to me, “Son of man, look with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all wey I go show you, because to di intent say I go show dem to you, you don dey brought here. Declare to di house of Israel all wey you see.”

See, wall dey outside di temple all round. Di measuring reed for di man hand na six cubits long, each of one cubit and one handbreadth. So e measure di thickness of di wall, one reed, and di height, one reed.
Den e come to di gate wey face toward di east, and go up im steps. E measure di threshold of di gate, one reed deep, and di other threshold, one reed deep.
Every guard chamber na one reed long, and one reed wide. Between di guard chambers na five cubits. Di threshold of di gate by di porch of di gate toward di temple na one reed.
E measure also di porch of di gate toward di temple, one reed.
Den e measure di porch of di gate, eight cubits, and im posts, two cubits. Di porch of di gate dey toward di temple.
Di guard chambers of di gate toward di east na three on dis side, and three on dat side. Dem three get one measure. Di posts get one measure on dis side and on dat side.
E measure di width of di entrance of di gate, ten cubits, and di length of di gate, 13 cubits.
Barrier dey before di guard chambers, one cubit on dis side, and barrier of one cubit on dat side. Di guard chambers na six cubits on dis side, and six cubits on dat side.
E measure di gate from di roof of one guard chamber to di roof of another, width of 25 cubits, door against door.
E measure also di posts, 60 cubits. Di court dey go to di post of di gate round about.
From di front of di gate of di entrance to di front of di porch of di inner gate na 50 cubits.
Narrow windows dey to di guard chambers, and to dem posts within di gate round about, and likewise to di arches. Windows dey round about inside. Upon each post na palm trees.
Den e bring me into di outer court. See, chambers dey, and pavement wey dem don make for di court round about. 30 chambers dey upon di pavement.
Di pavement by di side of di gates, wey correspond to di length of di gates, na di lower pavement.
Den e measure di breadth from di front of di lower gate to di front of di inner court outside, 100 cubits, on di east and on di north.
Di gate of di outer court wey face toward di north, e measure di length and di breadth of am.
Im guard chambers na three on dis side and three on dat side. Im posts and im arches get di same measure as di first gate. Di length of am na 50 cubits, and di breadth 25 cubits.
Im windows, and im arches, and im palm trees get di same measure as di gate wey face toward di east. Dem go up to am by seven steps. Im arches dey before dem.
Di gate of di inner court dey over against di gate toward di north, and toward di east. E measure from gate to gate 100 cubits.
Den e bring me toward di south, and see, gate dey toward di south. E measure im posts and im arches according to dem measures.
Windows dey inside am and inside im arches round about, like dem windows. Di length na 50 cubits, and di breadth 25 cubits.
Seven steps dey to go up to am, and im arches dey before dem. E get palm trees, one on dis side, and one on dat side, upon im posts.
Di inner court get gate toward di south. E measure from gate to gate toward di south, 100 cubits.
Den e bring me to di inner court by di south gate. E measure di south gate according to dem measures.
Im guard chambers, im posts, and im arches get di same measures. Windows dey inside am and inside im arches round about. Di length na 50 cubits, and di breadth 25 cubits.
Arches dey round about, 25 cubits long and five cubits wide.
Im arches dey toward di outer court. Palm trees dey upon im posts, and im ascent get eight steps.
Den e bring me into di inner court toward di east. E measure di gate according to dem measures.
Im guard chambers, im posts, and im arches get di same measures. Windows dey inside am and inside im arches round about. Di length na 50 cubits, and di breadth 25 cubits.
Im arches dey toward di outer court. Palm trees dey upon im posts, on dis side and on dat side, and im ascent get eight steps.
Den e bring me to di north gate. E measure am according to dem measures:
im guard chambers, im posts, and im arches. Windows dey inside am round about. Di length na 50 cubits, and di breadth 25 cubits.
Im posts dey toward di outer court. Palm trees dey upon im posts, on dis side and on dat side, and im ascent get eight steps.
One chamber dey with im door by di posts of di gates. Dere dem wash di burnt offering.
For di porch of di gate dey two tables on dis side, and two tables on dat side, to slaughter on dem di burnt offering, di sin offering, and di trespass offering.
For di outer side, as one go go up to di entrance of di gate toward di north, two tables dey. For di other side, wey dey di porch of di gate, two tables dey.
Four tables dey on dis side, and four tables on dat side, by di side of di gate. Eight tables, on which dem slaughter.

Four tables dey also for di burnt offering, of cut stone, one and half cubits long, and one and half cubits broad, and one cubit high, on which dem lay di instruments with which dem slaughter di burnt offering and di sacrifice.
Di ledges, one handbreadth wide, dey fastened inside round about. Di flesh of di offering dey upon di tables.
Outside di inner gate dey chambers for singers for di inner court, wey dey by di side of di north gate. Dem face toward di south, one by di side of di east gate wey face toward di north.
E talk to me, “Dis chamber, wey face toward di south, na for di priests, di keepers of di charge of di temple.
Di chamber wey face toward di north na for di priests, di keepers of di charge of di altar. Dem na di sons of Zadok, wey among di sons of Levi come near to di Lord to minister to am.”
E measure di court, 100 cubits long, and 100 cubits broad, foursquare. Di altar dey before di temple.

Den e bring me to di porch of di temple, and measure each post of di porch, five cubits on dis side, and five cubits on dat side. Di width of di gate na three cubits on dis side, and three cubits on dat side.
Di length of di porch na 20 cubits, and di breadth 11 cubits, even by di steps by which dem go up to am. Pillars dey by di posts, one on dis side, and one on dat side.
Den e bring me to di temple, and measure di posts, six cubits wide on one side, and six cubits wide on di other side, wey be di width of di tent.
Di width of di entrance na ten cubits. Di sides of di entrance na five cubits on dis side, and five cubits on dat side. E measure di length of am, 40 cubits, and di width, 20 cubits.
Den e go inside, and measure di post of di entrance, two cubits. Di entrance na six cubits, and di width of di entrance, seven cubits.
E measure di length of am, 20 cubits, and di width, 20 cubits, before di temple. E talk to me, “Dis na di most holy place.”
Den e measure di wall of di temple, six cubits. Di width of every side chamber, four cubits, round about di temple on every side.

Di side chambers dey three, one over another, and 30 for each story. Dem dey enter into di wall wey di temple get round about for di side chambers, so that dem fit hold fast, and no hold fast for di wall of di temple.

Di side chambers dey wider as dem go up round about di temple, because di structure go up round about di temple. Therefore di width of di temple dey increase as e go up, and so one go go up from di lowest story to di highest by di middle one.
I see also say di temple get raised platform all round. Di foundations of di side chambers dey full reed of six great cubits.
Di thickness of di wall wey di side chambers get outside na five cubits. Di free space between di side chambers wey di temple get
and di chambers dey 20 cubits wide round about di temple on every side.
Di doors of di side chambers dey toward di free space, one door toward di north, and one door toward di south. Di width of di free space na five cubits round about.
Di building wey dey before di separate place for di west side na 70 cubits wide. Di wall of di building na five cubits thick round about, and im length 90 cubits.
So e measure di temple, 100 cubits long. Di separate place, and di building, with im walls, na 100 cubits long.
Also di width of di face of di temple, and of di separate places toward di east, na 100 cubits.
E measure di length of di building before di separate place wey dey behind am, and im galleries on di one side and on di other side, 100 cubits, with di inner temple, and di porches of di court.

Di thresholds, and di narrow windows, and di galleries round about on dem three stories, over against di threshold, dey ceiled with wood round about, and from di ground up to di windows (now di windows dey covered),
to di space above di door, even to di inner house, and outside, and by all di wall round about inside and outside, by measure.
E dey made with cherubim and palm trees. Palm tree dey between cherub and cherub, and every cherub get two faces,
so that di face of man dey toward di palm tree for one side, and di face of young lion toward di palm tree for di other side. Dem dey made through all di house round about.
From di ground to above di door, cherubim and palm trees dey made, and on di wall of di temple.
Di door posts of di temple dey squared, and di face of di sanctuary na di same appearance.
Di altar na wood, three cubits high, and im length two cubits. Im corners, and im length, and im walls dey wood. E talk to me, “Dis na di table wey dey before di Lord.”
Di temple and di sanctuary get two doors.
Di doors get two leaves each, two turning leaves. Two for di one door, and two leaves for di other.
Cherubim and palm trees dey made on dem, on di doors of di temple, like dem wey dey made on di walls. Thick plank dey on di face of di porch outside.
Narrow windows and palm trees dey on di one side and on di other side, on di sides of di porch. Na so di side chambers of di house and di thick planks dey.
Den e bring me out into di outer court, di way toward di north. E bring me into di chamber wey dey over against di separate place, and wey dey over against di building toward di north.
Before di length of 100 cubits na di north door, and di width na 50 cubits.
Over against di 20 cubits wey belong to di inner court, and over against di pavement wey belong to di outer court, gallery dey over against gallery for three stories.
Before di chambers dey walk of ten cubits wide inward, a way of one cubit. Dem doors dey toward di north.
Now di upper chambers dey shorter, because di galleries take more space from dem than from di lower and di middle ones for di building.
Because dem dey for three stories, and dem no get pillars like di pillars of di courts. Therefore di upper dey set back from di ground more than di lowest and di middle.
Di wall wey dey outside, over against di chambers, toward di outer court before di chambers, na 50 cubits long.
Because di length of di chambers wey dey di outer court na 50 cubits. See, before di temple na 100 cubits.
Under dis chambers na di entry on di east side, as one go into dem from di outer court.
For di thickness of di wall of di court toward di east, before di separate place, and before di building, chambers dey.
Di way before dem like di appearance of di chambers wey dey toward di north. Dem length and dem width dey di same. All dem exits, and dem arrangements, and dem doors dey di same.
Like di doors of di chambers wey dey toward di south, door dey for di head of di way, even di way before di wall toward di east, as one go enter dem.

Den e talk to me, “Di north chambers and di south chambers, wey dey before di separate place, na di holy chambers, where di priests wey approach di Lord go eat di most holy things. Dere dem go lay di most holy things, di meal offering, di sin offering, and di trespass offering, because di place dey holy.

When di priests enter, den dem no go go out of di holy place into di outer court, but dere dem go lay dem garments wherein dem minister, because dem dey holy. Dem go put on other garments, and go approach dat wey belong to di people.”
Now when e don finish measuring di inner house, e bring me out toward di gate wey face toward di east, and measure am round about.
E measure di east side with di measuring reed, 500 reeds, with di measuring reed round about.
E measure di north side, 500 reeds, with di measuring reed round about.
E measure di south side, 500 reeds, with di measuring reed.
E turn about to di west side, and measure 500 reeds with di measuring reed.
E measure am on di four sides. E get wall round about, 500 reeds long and 500 wide, to make separation between di holy and di common.
Afterward e bring me to di gate, di gate wey face toward di east.
See, di glory of di God of Israel come from di way of di east. Im voice dey like di noise of many waters, and di earth shine with im glory.
Di appearance of di vision wey I see dey like di vision wey I see when I come to destroy di city. Di visions dey like di vision wey I see by di river Chebar. I fall on my face.
Di glory of di Lord come into di temple by di way of di gate wey face toward di east.
Di Spirit lift me up, and bring me into di inner court. See, di glory of di Lord fill di temple.
I hear one speak to me out of di temple, and man dey stand by me.

E talk to me, “Son of man, dis na di place of my throne, and di place of di soles of my feet, where I go dwell for di middle of di children of Israel forever. Di house of Israel no go defile my holy name any more, dem nor dem kings, by dem prostitution, and by di dead bodies of dem kings for dem high places,

by setting dem threshold by my threshold, and dem door post beside my door post, with only wall between me and dem. Dem don defile my holy name by dem abominations wey dem don commit. Therefore I don consume dem for my anger.
Now make dem put away dem prostitution, and di dead bodies of dem kings, far from me, and I go dwell for di middle of dem forever.
You, son of man, show di temple to di house of Israel, so that dem go dey ashamed of dem iniquities. Make dem measure di plan.

If dem dey ashamed of all wey dem don do, make known to dem di form of di temple, and di fashion of am, and im exits, and im entrances, and all im forms, and all im ordinances, and all im laws. Write am for dem sight, so that dem go keep di whole form of am, and all im ordinances, and do dem.
Dis na di law of di temple: Upon di top of di mountain, all di limit of am round about go be most holy. See, dis na di law of di temple.

Dis na di measures of di altar by cubits (di cubit na one cubit and one handbreadth): di base go be one cubit, and di breadth one cubit, and di border for di edge of am round about one span. Dis go be di base of di altar.
From di base upon di ground to di lower ledge go be two cubits, and di breadth one cubit. From di lesser ledge to di greater ledge go be four cubits, and di breadth one cubit.
Di altar hearth go be four cubits. From di altar hearth and upward dey four horns.
Di altar hearth go be 12 cubits long by 12 wide, square for im four sides.
Di ledge go be 14 cubits long by 14 wide for im four sides. Di border round about am go be half cubit, and di base of am go be one cubit round about. Im steps go face toward di east.”
E talk to me, “Son of man, di Lord God talk like dis: Dis na di ordinances of di altar for di day wey dem make am, to offer burnt offerings on am, and to sprinkle blood on am.
Una go give to di priests di Levites wey dey of di offspring of Zadok, wey approach me, to minister to me,” talk di Lord God, “bull for sin offering.
You go take some of im blood, and put am on di four horns of am, and on di four corners of di ledge, and on di border round about. Thus you go cleanse am and make atonement for am.
You go also take di bull of di sin offering, and e go dey burned for di appointed place of di temple, outside di sanctuary.
For di second day you go offer male goat without blemish for sin offering, and dem go cleanse di altar, as dem cleanse am with di bull.
When you don finish cleansing am, you go offer young bull without blemish, and ram out of di flock without blemish.
You go offer dem before di Lord, and di priests go cast salt on dem, and dem go offer dem up for burnt offering to di Lord.
Seven days you go prepare every day goat for sin offering. Dem go also prepare young bull, and ram out of di flock, without blemish.
Seven days dem go make atonement for di altar and purify am, so dem go consecrate am.
When dem don complete di days, e go be say on di eighth day, and afterward, di priests go make your burnt offerings on di altar, and your peace offerings, and I go accept una,” talk di Lord God.
